content.short: A feature-rich token explorer that enables you to see the prices of your favorite Cardano tokens in real time.
content.description:
Mardano is a feature-rich token explorer. See the prices of your favorite Cardano tokens in real time on any device. Discover price trends, the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation), 24h price change, price converter, TVL and much more. Token Tracking should be easier and even possible for non-tech users. Mardano aims to provide just that.

In the near future, we plan to introduce Cardano indices that will allow users to see price trends of specific sectors, such as lending and borrowing. Our mission: Making Cardano more accessible for everyone!
